chipmunk.name: Chip
chipmunk.description: A tiny, bright, high-pitched cartoon chipmunk. Fast, excitable, warm, slightly squeaky, youthful, very expressive.

wolf.name: Warden
wolf.description: A deep, calm, clear guardian with a wolf in his voice: a low rumbling growl sits under every word, slightly gravelly and husky, with a faint wolfish rasp at the start of phrases. Slow, steady, few words, protective, serious, never mean. Clear and easy to understand.

beaver.name: Archie
beaver.description: A calm, clear, trustworthy builder and engineer. Smooth mid-low pitch, never squeaky or shrill. Soft-spoken and relaxed volume, steady pace, crisp clear articulation. Quietly confident and optimistic, reassuring, sounds like an expert who knows exactly what he is talking about. Warm and friendly.

baseSettings.note: Archie speaks calmly; avoid exclamation marks in his lines. Team pick, Oct 4.

workspace.name: Pixel
workspace.description: A small, cute, very friendly helper character. Warm, sweet, bright and cheerful voice with a gentle smile in it, light and a little bouncy. Clever and upbeat, clear and easy to understand, slightly techy and tidy. Kind and welcoming, never robotic, never shrill.
